# Vendor Archive & Preservation Directory

This directory preserves core reference specifications, architecture definitions, and templates from upstream open-source projects adapted by `ai-dev-tools`.

## Offline Preservation Policy

All external tools and methodologies incorporated into `ai-dev-tools` maintain reference snapshots here. If an upstream repository is ever deleted, made private, or abandoned, the essential logic, templates, schemas, and algorithms remain permanently available and usable offline within this repository.

## Preserved Modules

- `vendor/astryx/`: Meta Astryx React 19 UI component templates, design token architecture, and agent CLI schemas.
- `vendor/rtk/`: RTK command-line output compression rules and token-reduction filter specifications.
- `vendor/ponytail/`: Dietrich Gebert's minimalist "lazy senior developer" decision ladder and YAGNI review patterns.
- `vendor/superpowers/`: Jesse Vincent's agentic software development methodology, TDD discipline, and verification gates.
- `vendor/code-review-graph/`: Tirth Patel's AST code graph schemas, blast-radius impact analysis, and dependency risk scoring algorithms.
- `vendor/context-mode/`: Mert Koseoglu's sandboxed tool execution and SQLite FTS5 documentation search patterns.
- `vendor/rust-anything/`: Erkam Yaman's incremental language-to-Rust migration harness, behavior recording, and replay gate patterns.
- `vendor/claude-bughunter/`: Static code security audit checklists and common vulnerability classification patterns.
